units.source_text: 可以想像我是怎样强忍住笑的。

en.t: You can imagine how hard I had to struggle to hold back my laughter.

units.source_text: 我丝毫也没有幻想我自己。

en.t: I had not deluded myself in the slightest.

units.source_text: 我知道，老寡妇一边念经，一边一个劲地膜拜我的脚。

en.t: I knew that the old widow, while chanting sutras, was ceaselessly worshiping my feet.

units.source_text: 我只顾思考着自己这双被地膜拜的脚，心里觉得几乎被这几分滑稽所窒息。

en.t: I thought only of my own feet being worshiped on the ground, and felt almost suffocated by the absurdity of it.

units.source_text: X型的腿、X型的腿，我只思想着它，脑子里只充塞着它。

en.t: Knock-kneed legs, knock-kneed legs; I thought only of them, and my mind was filled with nothing else.

units.source_text: 它是处在极其丑陋的状况。

en.t: They were in a state of extreme ugliness.
They were an absurd ugly farce.

units.source_text: 事实上，连连叩头的老寡妇的散发，触及了我的脚心，那几分痒劲愈发使我感到滑稽可笑了。

en.t: In fact, the loose hair of the old widow as she repeatedly bowed her head touched the soles of my feet, and that ticklish sensation made it seem even more ludicrous to me.
